description:
Navigate to the 'Positions' (or 'Relative Positions') activity in GCompris. This activity is typically found in the Reading or Discovery categories and features an icon with a box and a character (like a cat or dog) illustrating spatial positions. Once open, complete at least 5 rounds of the spatial reasoning quiz by clicking the word that describes the image (e.g., 'On', 'Under', 'Behind'). 

Save evidence of your work:
1. Take a screenshot of a question being displayed and save it to '~/Documents/positions_question.png'.
2. Take a screenshot showing the success feedback (smiley/animation) after a correct answer and save it to '~/Documents/positions_success.png'.
